## Projects

### StudentMind
- **URL**: https://studentmind-v1.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Yash-1505/studentmind-v1
- **Description**: Multi-mode AI study tool for students. Removes the prompt-engineering barrier. Supports 5 modes (summary, cheat sheet, learning path, quiz, resource finder), PDF/DOCX upload, voice input, 30-session chat history, PDF/DOCX export, rate limiting, and 16-language support via Sarvam AI. Zero backend — API keys stay local.
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Gemini API, Sarvam AI

### NotebookLM Prompt Vault
- **URL**: https://notebooklm-prompt-vault.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Yash-1505/notebooklm-prompt-vault
- **Description**: Batch-aware prompt library used by 500+ PIET students. Organises prompts by program, semester, subject, and unit from official syllabi across B.Tech AI/DS, AI/ML, and NNDL Diploma batches.
- **Stack**: JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Prompt Engineering
